_comment: Shared skill taxonomy. Add new skills here as repos require them — do not hardcode skills in Python files. Any team member can extend this list.
_note_on_extensibility: When a repository needs skills not in core_skills, the extraction prompt is allowed to propose new ones under a separate 'proposed_skills' field rather than forcing a bad fit into the fixed list. A human (any team member) reviews proposed_skills periodically and promotes good ones into core_skills.
